# CLI Command Index

Every `quipu` command path with its syntax, generated from the same catalogue that admits arguments, so it cannot list a command the binary refuses or miss one it accepts. `qp` is the same binary. Every command also takes `--db <path>` (default `.bobbin/quipu/quipu.db`). For explanations and examples see [CLI Commands](cli.md); `man quipu-<command>` prints the same syntax.

## `qp store`

Inspect native ownership, or explicitly adopt or restore a disk store.

Subcommands: `store status`, `store adopt`, `store restore`.

### `qp store status`

Report inactive or enforced native store ownership without adopting.

```text
qp store status
```

### `qp store adopt`

Bind an existing native store to this host and path with a fresh epoch.

```text
qp store adopt
```

### `qp store restore`

Restore a SQLite snapshot to a new path and explicitly adopt it.

```text
qp store restore <source.db>
```

## `qp version`

Print the version and source commit.

```text

```

## `qp trust-root`

Enroll the first human key of the root of trust.

Subcommands: `trust-root challenge`, `trust-root bootstrap`, `trust-root status`.

### `qp trust-root challenge`

Issue the proof-of-possession challenge for a first verifier key.

```text
qp trust-root challenge
```

Value options: `--verifier <VALUE>`, `--public-key <VALUE>`.

### `qp trust-root bootstrap`

Enroll the first verifier key with its signed challenge.

```text
qp trust-root bootstrap
```

Value options: `--verifier <VALUE>`, `--public-key <VALUE>`, `--pop-signature <VALUE>`, `--attests <VALUE>`.

### `qp trust-root status`

Show the root-of-trust state.

```text
qp trust-root status
```

## `qp graph`

Create, label, list, import, freeze and thaw named graphs and overlays.

Subcommands: `graph create`, `graph label`, `graph list`, `graph import`, `graph freeze`, `graph thaw`, `graph overlay-create`, `graph overlay-write`, `graph overlay-compose`.

### `qp graph create`

Register a committed named graph.

```text
qp graph create <iri>
```

Value options: `--actor <VALUE>`, `--timestamp <VALUE>`.

### `qp graph label`

Declare lattice labels on a registered graph.

```text
qp graph label <iri>
```

Value options: `--label <VALUE>`, `--actor <VALUE>`, `--timestamp <VALUE>`.

### `qp graph list`

List registered named graphs.

```text
qp graph list
```

Value options: `--kind <VALUE>`, `--graph <VALUE>`.

Switches: `--frozen`, `--json`.

### `qp graph import`

Import another store file as a named graph.

```text
qp graph import <db>
```

Value options: `--as <VALUE>`.

### `qp graph freeze`

Freeze a graph's full history into a read-only archive pack.

```text
qp graph freeze <iri>
```

Value options: `--out <VALUE>`, `--actor <VALUE>`.

### `qp graph thaw`

Restore a frozen graph from its archive pack.

```text
qp graph thaw <iri>
```

Value options: `--actor <VALUE>`.

### `qp graph overlay-create`

Create an overlay graph bound to a committed parent.

```text
qp graph overlay-create
```

Value options: `--input <VALUE>`.

### `qp graph overlay-write`

Assert, retract or tombstone a triple in an overlay.

```text
qp graph overlay-write
```

Value options: `--input <VALUE>`.

### `qp graph overlay-compose`

Resolve an overlay's composed view over its parent.

```text
qp graph overlay-compose
```

Value options: `--input <VALUE>`.

## `qp db`

Respace, attach or migrate the store file.

Subcommands: `db respace`, `db attach`, `db migrate-inferred`.

### `qp db respace`

Copy the store into a term space.

```text
qp db respace
```

Value options: `--into <VALUE>`, `--out <VALUE>`.

### `qp db attach`

List the databases mounted alongside this store.

```text
qp db attach
```

Switches: `--list`.

### `qp db migrate-inferred`

Move engine-derived facts into their companion inferred graphs.

```text
qp db migrate-inferred
```

## `qp events`

Read store event records such as refusals.

Subcommands: `events refusals`.

### `qp events refusals`

List recorded write refusals.

```text
qp events refusals
```

## `qp fork`

Create, list, diff, drop or promote named forks of ROOT.

```text
qp fork <tx>
```

Value options: `--name <VALUE>`, `--timestamp <VALUE>`.

### `qp fork list`

List named forks.

```text
qp fork list
```

### `qp fork diff`

Diff two forks.

```text
qp fork diff <a> <b>
```

### `qp fork drop`

Drop a named fork.

```text
qp fork drop <name>
```

### `qp fork promote`

Promote a fork to ROOT, with reviewable conflict decisions.

```text
qp fork promote <name>
```

Value options: `--timestamp <VALUE>`, `--emit-decisions <VALUE>`, `--decisions <VALUE>`, `--reviewer <VALUE>`, `--actor <VALUE>`.

Switches: `--propose`, `--dry-run`.

## `qp audit`

Check traces, namespaces, replays and quarantine against policy.

```text
qp audit <trace.jsonl>
```

Value options: `--repo <VALUE>`, `--from <VALUE>`, `--to <VALUE>`, `--yupana <VALUE>`.

Switches: `--json`.

### `qp audit inventory`

List the policies the audit checks against.

```text
qp audit inventory
```

Switches: `--json`.

### `qp audit namespace`

Report base-namespace drift.

```text
qp audit namespace
```

Value options: `--graph <VALUE>`.

Switches: `--json`.

### `qp audit replay`

Re-derive a gate decision as of its transaction.

```text
qp audit replay <trace.jsonl|verdict>
```

Value options: `--delta <VALUE>`.

Switches: `--json`.

### `qp audit tree`

Reassemble the dispatch forest from a trace's principal chains.

```text
qp audit tree <trace.jsonl>
```

Switches: `--json`.

### `qp audit inheritance`

Check whether inherited constraints stopped applying under delegation.

```text
qp audit inheritance <trace.jsonl>
```

Switches: `--json`.

### `qp audit quarantine`

List refused-attempt evidence behind verdicts.

```text
qp audit quarantine
```

Value options: `--verdict <VALUE>`.

Switches: `--json`.

#### `qp audit quarantine list`

List refused-attempt evidence, optionally for one verdict.

```text
qp audit quarantine list
```

Value options: `--verdict <VALUE>`.

Switches: `--json`.

#### `qp audit quarantine purge`

Purge quarantined evidence by graph, age or all.

```text
qp audit quarantine purge
```

Value options: `--graph <VALUE>`, `--before <VALUE>`, `--older-than <VALUE>`.

Switches: `--all`, `--json`.
